pick.headline: Carter and Brezhnev sign SALT II in Vienna
pick.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of June 18, 1979, opened with a run of bloc media views on the Vienna summit and SALT II, including TANJUG expecting 'No Surprises' and Prague saying the pact 'Could Have Been Better'.
